notes.title: The Trackmania World Tour 2025 is back in 2v2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CjSgKtVnd_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We are delighted to launch the 2025 esports competitive season of the Trackmania World Tour and announce the highly anticipated return of the 2-drivers team format. The new competition circuit will allow all players and clubs from around the world to participate in official and community tournaments, regardless of their level.

During the 8 months of competition starting now, clubs will be able to defend their colors and players to showcase their talent in numerous homologated tournaments organized by our partner Toornament and the community tournament organizers. The season will conclude with the Trackmania World Cup where the best teams will attempt to win the title of Trackmania Team World Champion 2025 and succeed the 2023 winner: Karmine Corp.

[h2]Participate in competitions from anywhere[/h2]
Teams will have the choice to compete in one of three regions available (EMEA, NCSA, and APAC) and climb their respective ranking by earning points in homologated tournaments. These tournaments will be divided into two categories, awarding teams different levels of points:

●	Eight guaranteed online “Official Tournament” per region
●	Unlimited “Community Tournaments” organized online and/or LAN

Community organizers will be able to help teams earn points in their respective ranking by having their tournaments homologated, whether they are open to players from one region or all. For organizers, the duo game mode has been specially updated to use and customize for their events.

[h2]Become the best team in the world[/h2]
In addition to the homologated tournaments, two Global Playoffs will be held during the season. These competitions will take place in early July and early October, and will combine the top sixteen teams from the three regional rankings. They will have the opportunity to compete to earn points in their respective regional rankings and share a prize of $5,000 in each Global Playoffs.

At the end of the season, the best ranked team from each regional ranking and the winner of the second Global Playoffs will earn their slot for the Trackmania World Cup 2025. More details on the Finals will be shared at a later date.

[h2]Get ready and register your duo[/h2]
It's time to build your team and hit the slopes of the first official track pack available in the 2025 World Tour in-game club.

Teams and players can find all the information they need to:

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/en_US/register-team]Register their roster[/url] 

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/en_US/organizers]Homologate their tournament[/url]

[url=https://bit.ly/tmwt25-rulebook]Consult the competition rulebook[/url]

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/en_US/tournament-calendar]Discover the calendar with the first official and community tournaments[/url] 

We wish you all a great 2025 competitive season in duo on Trackmania!

notes.title: Weekly Shorts - New Rules & Guidelines
notes.content:
We recently introduced the Weekly Shorts game-mode to provide 5 new challenges each week at Sunday 6PM CET. The game-mode is popular and we can see many players enjoying and trying the tracks!

Since the game-mode is aimed more towards the beginner player, and players we welcome in Trackmania may try these challenges quickly when discovering the game, we want to introduce a few more rules & guidelines to submitting tracks for the Weekly Shorts.

The aim is to reduce the difficulties of tracks that we see are being submitted, increase their readability for beginners, and make selection for your tracks more likely.

[b]Find below the rules we are introducing.[/b] For a more detailed explanation and to provide clarity on these changes, we also attached some [url=https://doc.trackmania.com/create/map-review/weekly-shorts-guidelines/]documentation[/url]

* Track length (Author time) must not be longer than 20 seconds.
* Tracks visibility and readability must fit the beginner player.
* Tracks must fit one of 5 Track Styles:

[b]Wide[/b] - Experience gameplay with no frustration of collisions.
[b]Slow[/b] - Enrich gameplay with the brakes and without the stress of speed.
[b]Puzzle[/b] - Enjoy finding cuts without having to drive well.
[b]Fast[/b] - Enjoy the adrenaline with no complexity.
[b]LOL[/b] - Enjoy creativity & fun of luck with no specific skill to win.

* Each week will have 1 track type of each in this exact order.
* Your track must be submitted for a style, by prefixing it with a number in the Track Name.
* Preferably, your track is also named simply, describing the track theme in the Track Name.
* New labels & Tags are introduced for the Weekly Shorts Map Review.
* More feedback from Nadeo after review, via the use of new labels.

[i]Example of track naming: 2-Forestpath By MissPlease[/i]

Organizing the tracks into five styles should also help new players discover the many ways to enjoy Trackmania’s rich gameplay!
For those seeking higher challenges, they can chase records, compete in Track of the Day, tackle higher-level campaign tracks, and take on community-driven in-game activities.

This week’s selection already reflects this vision! Enjoy!

notes.title: Winter update: Weekly Shorts and more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5v312Tmynls;full][/previewyoutube]

Accessible to all players with [b]FREE[/b] Starter Access* and fueled by community creativity, Weekly Shorts brings you back to the core of the “easy to pick up, hard to master” Trackmania experience.  

[b]Each Sunday at 6 PM CET, five new tracks will be released, allowing players to race for medals and climb both track and weekly rankings, with trophies awarded at the end of the week. [/b]

These tracks are playable in [b]solo, online, and local multiplayer modes[/b], with a new menu button making it easy to launch tracks directly into[b] hotseat local multiplayer for quick games with friends on consoles with only one controller. [/b]

*Club Access players can access ALL Weekly Shorts from their launch, while Starter Access players can only enjoy the current Weekly Shorts campaign. 

[h2]Want to Submit Your Track?[/h2]

A dedicated Weekly Shorts Track Review is open, where creators can submit tracks for consideration. Key selection criteria include track length, readability, challenge and fun! 

[h1]More updates[/h1]

Additional optimizations including a refreshed User Interface, are also part of this update. You can find all the details in the [url=https://www.trackmania.com/news/8442]changelog[/url] 

[h2]Hylis introduces key concepts for this update[/h2]

[h3]Challenges[/h3]

For the Shorts tracks, I would like to focus on key elements and introduce the "Challenges" track type. 

Trackmania's rich array of blocks, physics, and gameplay mechanics offers countless possibilities. By having over 250 Challenges annually, players will have an excellent way to explore these features. [b]These tracks should be designed with clear physics & gameplay obstacles that will make players think & try twice, or more! [/b]

[b]Challenges aim to bring the fun of progression[/b] and offer insights into various aspects of Trackmania's rich gameplay.  

[b]They’re also perfect for Hot Seat mode, since you can challenge your friends and experience good surprises thanks to physics or ideas. [/b]

[h3]Top Secret[/h3]

Shorts will also bring more frequent competitive solo content alongside the Seasonnal Campaign. 

We introduce the new "Top Secret" feature. [b]Best times & ghosts will remain hidden until the end of the Weekly Shorts hunting period.[/b] [b]This system should encourage exploration and strategy, as players might discover rare techniques to secure top rankings. [/b]Every Sunday at 6 p.m. CET, the leaderboard will lock, and the best times and ghosts will be revealed. 

This “Top Secret” feature can also be applied to user-made tracks, offering players a way to keep their training strategies private until an event. 

[h3]Like/Dislike[/h3]

Track of the Day remains a great place for the more regular player with the best daily addition possible. 

To achieve this and especially try to ensure fairness for mappers, [b]we have introduced "like/dislike" feature to improve track ratings. [/b]This will help review servers identify those who provide good and fair ratings. ^_^  

[h1]Winter Campaign Drops January 1st[/h1]

[b]Mark your calendars for January 1st at 5 PM CET, when we release the new 25-tracks Winter campaign. [/b]

We wish you all a joyful Holiday Season, and we’ll see you in 2025! 🎉

notes.title: Get Ready for the Trackmania World Cup 2024 – It's Finally Here!
notes.content:
[u][b]8 FINALISTS, ONLY ONE CHAMPION[/b][/u]

The Trackmania World Cup 2024, supported by Continental, promises an intense showdown between the 8 best players from the regular season and direct qualifiers.

One of the favorites is [b]CarlJr.[/b], the last solo winner in 2022. Winner of the American regional qualifiers, the Solary player will be aiming to reclaim his crown and add a new world title to his unmatched awards.

Standing in his way is [b]Otaaaq[/b], the Karmine Corp player and reigning 2023 duo champion. Otaaaq will defend his title and seek a second world champion title in front of the French crowd in Paris.

Another strong contender is [b]Binkss[/b], one of 2024’s breakout stars. Ranked first in the TMWT 2024 world ranking, the Frenchman has displayed remarkable consistency, securing first and second places in events like the Playoffs, Encore tournament, Comic Con Baltics, and Monthly Cups.

[b]Massa[/b], a veteran from the German team BIG, is also among the favorites. He earned his place in the finals with a stellar performance in the Playoffs tournament.

The youngest of the finalists, [b]Pusztitopako[/b] from the Hungarian team Into The Breach, has had a breakout season, rising to second place in the world rankings. His string of podium finishes and first-place results makes him a formidable challenger.

[b]Epos[/b], from the English team BLUEJAYS Sport, is a strong title contender after an outstanding 2024 season. Finishing fourth in the Playoffs, he has consistently secured podium finishes across numerous events. He also claimed victory in the XPEvo tournament, defeating some of Europe’s top players.

[b]Pac[/b], another Englishman, will also be vying for the title. He secured the final slot for Paris by finishing second at the XPEvo tournament. A 2023 finalist with Solary, Pac has consistently performed well, including a podium finish at the GameWard Cup Major.

Finally, Australian player [b]Mudda[/b] will be looking to improve on his 3rd place finish in the 2023 duo event. His victory in the Rest of the World regional qualifiers and extensive experience at the highest level make him a serious competitor.

[u][b]WORLD CUP FORMAT AND SCHEDULE [/b][/u]

[b]The World Cup will be played in a single-elimination bracket, with matches in a 1vs1vs1vs1 format. [/b]Players will compete on the official map pack designed for the final, which was also used during the Playoffs. These challenging, highly technical maps promise to deliver a thrilling show.

[b]Both the semi-finals and the final will take place on the main stage at Paris Games Week, in front of thousands of in-person spectators and many more watching online. The action kicks off at 11:30 AM CEST on Friday, October 25.[/b]

For fans wanting to support their favorite players in person, head to Hall 3 of Paris Games Week. Tickets and further information can be found on the official event website at www.parisgamesweek.com.


[u][b]STREAMERS BRINGING THE ACTION TO LIFE[/b][/u]

The medals you’ll earn on each track are based on the number of respawns recorded by the authors.  You can earn:

[*] a bronze medal with a maximum of 30 respawns more than the author[/list]

You can play the new Platform mode online with your friends thanks to club rooms, local servers, and split screen, or enjoy the Solo Discovery Campaign in the campaigns library. 5 platform tracks will be available in-game at launch, with an additional five tracks added every Monday at 5 PM CEST for the next 4 weeks following the campaign release.

notes.title: TMWT MAY 2024 RECAP!
notes.content:
The month of May in the Trackmania World Tour was marked by the organization of Comic Con Baltics, the first major tournament of the season. Its results, along with those of the Trackmania Monthly Cup, significantly changed the World Ranking.

[h3]STUFTS, FIRST MAJOR CHAMPION[/h3]
The second Trackmania Monthly Cup kept all its promises shwocasing a very high level of play among more than 70 participants. They had several additional weeks to practice on the official map pack. Ultimately, it was the English player Robert “Epos” McKay who won the final, ahead of Canadian Carl-Antoni “CarlJr” Cloutier and Dutch Mees “Stufts” Jenema. This great victory allowed Epos to temporarily take the lead in the World Ranking before Comic Con Baltics.

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/fr/tournament/7655311590029303808]Get tournament results and ranking >[/url]

Comic Con Baltics in Vilnius concluded after two days of competition, bringing together 32 of the top European players from the online qualifying stages. The results confirmed the excellent form of several players. Notably, three of the four finalists had already reached the final of the Trackmania Monthly Cup of May: Hubert ‘mime’ Dziedzic, Robert ‘Epos’ McKay, and Mees ‘Stufts’ Jenema. It was Jenema who won the final, earning an additional 2000 points in the World Ranking. The tournament also spotlighted the formidable talent of Frenchman Alexandre ‘Binkss’ Touche, who clinched an impressive second place on the podium.

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/fr/tournament/7719668060524396544]Get tournament results and ranking >[/url]

[h3]A BUSY MONTH OF JUNE[/h3]
June is packed with action, featuring several homologated tournaments, including the second Major category competition of the season. Organized by Gameward, this event will take place on June 22nd and 23rd, offering numerous points in the Trackmania World Ranking. The top players will also compete for a €1,300 cash prize and two tickets to the Monza Grand Prix in Italy.

Additionally, a series of four online Community Cups will be held in June and July. Two of these have been homologated in the Challenger Tournament category, while the other two fall under the Grand Tournament category.

With the Trackmania Monthly Cup and LAN ETS in Montreal also on the agenda, June promises large opportunities for players to earn additional points in the World Ranking.

[url=https://esports.trackmania.com/fr/tournament-calendar]Check the tournament calendar page >
[/url]
If you are an organizer or team looking to have your tournament homologated in the Trackmania World Tour, visit our dedicated page for more information.

[h3]FIRST CHANGES AT THE TOP OF THE WORLD RANKING[/h3]
The Trackmania World Ranking saw significant shifts between April and May. Alexandre “Binkss” Touche had to relinquish first place to Mees “Stufts” Jenema, the winner of Comic Con Baltics. Robert “Epos” McKay climbed from 7th to 3rd place, ahead of Poland’s Hubert “mime” Dziedzic, who moved up two spots.

While a few players have emerged at the top with over 1000 points each, the rest of the ranking remains highly competitive, with many positions still up for grabs for securing a slot in the Playoffs. The ranking could change dramatically with the introduction of the new official map pack and the five tournaments scheduled in June!

notes.title: Revealing the first details of the 2024 Trackmania esports circuit
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that the new 2024 competitive season on Trackmania is officially kicking off. With a revamped format, the Trackmania World Tour will allow amateur and professional players as well as, for the first time, community tournament organizers, to take part and play an active role in shaping the storylines of the season.

Co-organized with our new partner Toornament, the Trackmania World Tour 2024 will include a regular season where players will compete for points which, at the end of the season, will determine if they qualify to the Finals. The Finals will include playoffs, followed by a World Cup. During the World Cup, the community will have the opportunity to watch the best Trackmania players in the world compete for the title and a share of the 18,000€ total prizepool. More details on the Finals will be shared at a later date.

Here’s everything you need to know on the Trackmania World Tour 2024 Regular Season!

Season 2024 will run from March to September.

This year, the Trackmania World Tour and the qualification for the season Finals, will be based on a Global Point System and the players’ placement on the World Ranking.

To grab points, players will participate in 1vs1vs1vs1 offline and online homologated tournaments.

This is where community tournament organizers have an exciting new opportunity to contribute to the emergence of future champions. By getting their tournaments homologated, they will be able to distribute points to participants, which will affect their placement on the World Ranking.

Depending on their scope and size, the tournaments will be divided into 3 categories, which will determine the number of points that are up for grabs:
[list][*] Major Tournament – up to 2000 points for the winner
[*] Grand Tournament – up to 1000 points for the winner
[*] Challenger Tournament – up to 500 points for the winner[/list]
In addition to the community-organized tournaments, Ubisoft will set up 6 monthly cups from April to September. The first one will be organized on April 28th. More details will be given shortly, stay tuned.

Starting now, details about the 2024 regular season can be found on the new competition platform www.trackmania.com/esports. Organizers can already start registering to get a license to organize tournaments and start their homologation process, while players can register and check out various opportunities to compete and earn points. This season, tournaments organizers have the possibility to use official tracks available in the Trackmania World Tour ingame Club to create their events.

More information on the 2024 activities and Season Finals will be communicated throughout the season. Follow the latest news on https://esports.trackmania.com, on https://twitter.com/TMesports and on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/trackmania

We wish you all a great 2024 competitive season on Trackmania!

notes.title: CELEBRATE TRACKMANIA’S 20TH ANNIVERSARY TODAY WITH NEW CONTENT & LIVE ACTIVITIES
notes.content:
Trackmania is celebrating its 20th anniversary with an array of new content and engaging activities. 

On November 21st, 2003, Trackmania made its debut, introducing the gaming world to "fun and addictive" online races, fueled by player-created content and featuring groundbreaking multiplayer technology with a no-collision approach. The first title showcased three iconic environments: Desert, Rally, and Snow, known as the “Trackmania Original environments”. 

Fast forward 20 years, 14 installments, and 48 million players, we are delighted to unveil the “Original Trilogy” coming to Trackmania through mini-remakes accessible directly in the game. This is made possible by a new feature allowing the Stadium car to transform into the 3 historic cars. 
[list][*] The first of the three upcoming episodes, released today, introduces the Snow car, which plays like its 2003 counterpart with modern twists. 
[*] In addition, a new type of competitive road surface - wood- has been developed, providing a new unique gameplay experience to the Stadium car. 
[*] To complement these new racing features, rediscover the Asian atmosphere from the initial Snow environment thanks to 100 new 3D blocks and items created for the occasion.[/list]

Accompanying this exciting content drop, we are hosting various live activities with Trackmania goodies prizes: 
[list][*] Tonight (and tomorrow), at 7PM CET, a very special Track Of The Day will kick off the celebration with the Cup Of The Day, as well as the Snow Discovery campaign of 15 tracks. 
[*] A group of 10 streamers, including Bren, Karlberg, Lars, Majijej, SBVille, Spam, TrilluXe, Wingobear, Wirtual, and Yannex, will craft their own track, forming a unique streamers campaign that will be released on December 4th. Until then, check out your favorite streamers' Twitch channel to follow their mapping, and start playing their track in their in-game clubs! 
[*] These same tracks will be featured in the Trackmania 20th-anniversary competition on December 18th where you will be able to compete. 
[*] On November 30, Ubisoft News will livestream the Cup of the Day at 6:30PM CEST/9:30AM PT, joined by Trackmania Producer Augustin De Vita and Content Manager Ayrton Lemaire.[/list]

Additionally, the studio held a car-skinning contest in honor of the 20th anniversary, and players can now head over to the in-game Ubisoft Nadeo club to check out the top 10 player-crafted skins, chosen by a jury of community members and Nadeo staff.  

To add the perfect finishing touch, don’t miss the Trackmania World Championship Finals. They will be broadcasted live from ZQSD studios in Montpellier next weekend, spanning from November 24th to 26th! We invite everyone to connect online, encourage and cheer for their champions! Catch the entire event [url=https://www.twitch.tv/trackmania]on the Twitch channels of Trackmania [/url][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/trackmania]and teams’ streamers[/url]. [url=https://www.trackmania.com/news/7797]All info are available in the dedicated news article. [/url]

notes.title: TRACKMANIA STARTER ACCESS UPDATE & NEW OFFER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to share with you an important upcoming change regarding the Trackmania offer.

While the console release has surpassed our highest expectations in terms of both amount of players and playing time, we need to adapt the quantity of content given for free with the Starter Access, to better match the way the game is played. We also have to be realistic and compare the situation with the efforts made by the studio.

As a result, we have decided that going forward, Trackmania Starter Access will give access to 10 free tracks at each new season.

Starter Access will continue to provide free access to Royal & Ranked modes (including the full tracks) and to the 10 first campaign tracks in solo and live menus. Starter Access players will also retain access to the Arcade channel, which allows them to explore and enjoy the finest creations crafted by fellow players. This will be applicable with the next Winter 2024 update.

Be sure we understand that many of you have become accustomed to playing the full campaign for free and we would have preferred to keep it that way. This adjustment is being made to ensure that we can keep on providing Starter Access users with various free content. Our primary goal is to keep Trackmania live as long as possible, and have it enjoyed by a maximum player from around the world thanks to the right balance for players who play for free and others who are making it possible for two decades.

We will also streamline the Trackmania offers by merging the content of both Standard and Club accesses into a single CLUB ACCESS offer, for an annual cost of 19.99€/$19.99. Players currently on Standard or Club accesses will maintain their status until their access expires. This will also be applicable with the next Winter 2024 update.

Finally, to better accommodate real-life constraints, we're targeting a new release date for the Winter Campaign 2024. Feel free to note in your calendar that the new date is set for January 9th. 

Meanwhile, the Trackmania 20th anniversary is approaching in late November. We're looking forward to having you join us for this incredible milestone!

Thank you for your understanding and continued support for 20 years.

Ubisoft Nadeo Team.

notes.title: TRACKMANIA 20-YEAR SKIN CONTEST
notes.content:
2023 is a special year for Trackmania, as we celebrate the 20-year anniversary of the brand! The very first Trackmania game was launched in France on November 21, 2003. To mark this milestone, we have planned various events, starting with a special Trackmania 20-year anniversary skin contest! 
 
This activity is open to everyone. Design your own Trackmania car skin around the following theme: “Celebrating the Trackmania 20-year anniversary!” 
 
To take part in the contest, you need to send your Trackmania livery file (.zip), a short description of your car skin, and fill in all the information needed through the [url=https://forms.office.com/r/mbjzCe60vT]dedicated form[/url]. Submission deadline is set to Sunday, October 22nd, 11:59 PM CE(S)T. 


[h2]RULES[/h2]
The car livery must be designed around the following theme: “Celebrating the Trackmania 20-year anniversary!”. 
 
A player can only send one single car skin. 
 
The livery must be designed on the Trackmania (2020) 3D model, and the submitted file must be usable in-game in Trackmania (2020). 
 
The design can be created with the in-game skin editor, or any other design software. 
 
Feel free to use any Trackmania or Ubisoft Nadeo related logo. In-game skin editor logos from the previous Trackmania games (Turbo, ManiaPlanet, TrackMania Forever...) are allowed. Logos related to any other brand are strictly forbidden. 


[h2]SCHEDULE[/h2]
The Trackmania 20-year skin contest starts on Friday, September 1, 2023. 
 
Submission deadline is set to Sunday, October 22nd at 11:59 PM CE(S)T. 
 
The community vote will start on Wednesday, November 1st and will be closed on Sunday, November 12th at 11:59 PM CE(S)T. 
 
Final results will be announced on Tuesday, November 21st.


[h2]RESULTS[/h2]
The top 10 car skins will qualify for the open community vote. This selection will be made by Ubisoft Nadeo. These skins will be available in Ubisoft Nadeo’s in-game club beginning on Monday, October 30th. 
 
The top 10 ranking will be decided thanks to the community vote (50%), but also thanks to a dedicated jury (50%). The jury will be announced in October.


[h2]PRICES[/h2]
1st: 250€ + goodies pack 
2nd: 150€ + goodies pack 
3rd: 100€ + goodies pack 
4th to 10th: Goodies pack 
 
To be eligible to win prize money, the player must be able to edit an invoice (thanks to self-employment or freelance status). If this is not possible, an equivalent prize will be found in agreement with the organizer and the winner. 
 
Good luck designing your own Trackmania car skin, we are truly excited to see your submissions!
